description: Prepares deleting a saved quote for good: returns the summary to show the customer and a confirmation_token. Nothing is deleted until confirm is called with it after the customer agrees. Accepted and ordered quotes cannot be deleted. Needs a signed-in Printdash account: called without one, the connection asks the customer to sign in on printdash.io.

quote.description: The quote number (or the quote id from its link).

name: delete_quote

summary.description: Show this to the customer exactly as written before confirming.

title: Delete a saved quote (asks first)
